author: Live Tennis API
name: LiveTennis
short: Live tennis scores, match details, head-to-head and player lookups.
description: Live tennis scores from livetennisapi.com covering ATP, WTA, Challenger, ITF and juniors: live matches with per-set scores and a serving indicator, upcoming matches, results, single-match detail, player search, head-to-head records and top-10 rankings. Query-driven (no background polling); responses are cached for 60 seconds to respect the free API tier. Requires a free API key from https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free.
install_msg: LiveTennis installed! The bot owner should set an API key with `[p]tennisset apikey <key>` (free key at <https://livetennisapi.com/subscribe/free>), then try `[p]tennis live`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. The bot owner's Live Tennis API key is stored using Red's shared API token storage.
